rows.details: Health Policy and Integrated Planning/ Human Resources for Health division
Senior Consultant – Health Policy and Integrated Planning/ Human Resources for Health
Contractual; contract till 31st March 2028, extendable subject to satisfactory performance
Up to 50 Years (as on the date of receiving the application)
New Delhi (with travel to states and districts)

content_sections.heading: About NHSRC
content_sections.text: The National Health Systems Resource Centre has been set up under the National Health Mission as an autonomous registered society to channelise technical assistance and capacity-building support to the states for strengthening the public health system. It is also mandated to contribute to health policy and programme design and evaluation, and the notice states that it has been working since 2006. The Health Policy and Integrated Planning/ Human Resources for Health division supports the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare (MoHFW) and the states in strengthening integrated planning under NHM, developing comprehensive strategies for Human Resources for Health (HRH), technical support and capacity building on public health planning and HRH management, implementing a health systems approach, and Results Based Financing/ Conditionalities Assessment. The team also conducts studies for evidence-based plans related to HRH/HPIP.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: MBBS/ BDS/ B.Sc. Nursing/ Bachelor of Science (any stream)/ Bachelor of Engineering/ BA- Economics with a full time 2 years post-graduation in any one of the following: Master of Public Health (MPH) Postgraduate in Community Medicine/ Preventive & Social Medicine Postgraduate Degree/ Diploma in Public Health Management Postgraduate Degree/ Diploma in Healthcare Administration Postgraduate Degree/ Diploma in Health/ Hospital Management Post Graduate Degree/ Diploma/ MBA in Personal Management Post Graduate Degree/ Diploma/ MBA in HR Management Only full-time regular bachelor's degrees (minimum 3 years) and full-time regular postgraduate qualifications (minimum 2 years), wherever applicable, are considered. Diploma, certificate and Executive programmes, and qualifications obtained through distance, online, part-time or correspondence mode, are not considered. At least 5 years of post-qualification experience in the public health sector. Only post-qualification experience is counted. Preference would be given to those who have practised medicine in PHC/blocks or have been part of NHM. Work experience or competence in planning for health, health systems strengthening or Human Resources for Health, particularly at National/ State level, would be an advantage. Understanding of Human Resources for Health and other health issues in the Indian context Computer proficiency with commonly used packages like MS Word, Excel and Power Point, and being internet savvy to search relevant data and documents Excellent writing and analytical skills Understanding of research and knowledge of qualitative and quantitative research methodologies Ability to triangulate and analyse data (qualitative and quantitative) and prepare reports Ability to work in a team, mentor team members and handle different assignments simultaneously to meet timelines The notice also lists other qualities: being an avid and fast learner, passion for public health issues, flexibility to put in hours beyond usual office timing to finish tasks on time, good follow-through and attention to quality, and willingness to travel to states and districts to provide technical assistance. Up to 50 Years, as on the date of receiving the application. The notice does not mention any age relaxation. Candidates should check the official notification for the complete eligibility conditions of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The remuneration range is between Rs. 90,000/- and Rs. 1,50,000/- per month. The fee offered within the band will be commensurate with qualification and experience. In addition to the remuneration, Consultants of NHSRC are entitled to: Free accidental insurance and subsidised medical insurance Mobile bills reimbursement and laptop reimbursement (as per NHSRC Policy) 30 days consolidated leave Fully paid maternity leave for female consultants, as per Government of India policy Performance-linked increments TA/ DA and per diem for on-duty visits The position is on a contractual basis and reports to the Advisor – Human Resource for Health/ Health Policy and Integrated Planning. The notice says the engagement is "to begin with Two years and extendable based on the Performance", and under Duration of Contract it states: contract till 31st March 2028 with further extensions of similar duration, subject to satisfactory performance.

content_sections.heading: NHSRC Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Provide policy and programme support for Human Resources for Health/ Health Policy and Integrated Planning at national and state level. Provide technical support to states in strengthening their planning and HRH management practices as per policies and directives of MoHFW and achievement of targets. Provide technical assistance in areas related to health systems strengthening. Monitor the progress of the division's work plan and ensure timely completion. Plan, develop and implement strategies for capacity building of Human Resources for Health at State and district levels. Undertake regular field visits for monitoring and supportive supervision on planning, HRH and programme management, especially to low performing States/ Districts/ Cities. Mentor consultants and junior consultants; review and supervise their tasks and documents and share revised documents with the Advisor for final review. Lead assessment/ research studies as per the work plan: develop study protocol and guide, guide consultants on methodology, analysis framework and tools, monitor progress, and finalise documents for the Reporting Officer. Identify best practices and innovations within States and districts and support States/UTs to document them. Prepare technical briefs, operational and technical guidelines, notes, reports, presentations, case studies and training material, and ensure their dissemination. Prepare responses to queries and RTI received, and maintain a database of documents and data related to the allocated work area. Undertake other assignments given from time to time by the Reporting Officer.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NHSRC Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates must fill the online application form available on the NHSRC website ( http://nhsrcindia.org ). Applications are accepted only in the prescribed online application format, and the last date for receiving applications is 15 December 2026. The notice does not list documents to upload or any application fee.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The selection process comprises a written test (objective and subjective), an analytical test, computer proficiency and a personal interview. Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria will be informed separately about these stages. If the recruitment process includes a written test, the minimum qualifying mark will be 70%. If the number of qualifying candidates is high, a ratio of 1:5 will be adopted for 1 vacancy, and the top 5 candidates will be considered. If 2 or more candidates qualify with the same marks, all such candidates will be considered.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: NHSRC has a strict probation policy; those who do not meet the stated requirements are not confirmed. Travel to states and districts will be involved in the job. Candidates selected in this interview could be considered for other vacant positions at NHSRC requiring similar skill sets and at an appropriate level.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NHSRC Senior Consultant post?
faq.answer: The last date for receiving online applications is 15 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What qualification is required for NHSRC Senior Consultant?
faq.answer: Candidates need MBBS/ BDS/ B.Sc. Nursing/ Bachelor of Science (any stream)/ Bachelor of Engineering/ BA- Economics with a full-time 2-year post-graduation in one of seven listed subjects, such as MPH or Health/ Hospital Management.

faq.question: Q3. How much experience is needed?
faq.answer: At least 5 years of post-qualification experience in the public health sector is required, with preference to those who have practised medicine in PHC/blocks or have been part of NHM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for NHSRC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The age limit is up to 50 Years, as on the date of receiving the application.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of an NHSRC Senior Consultant?
faq.answer: The remuneration range is Rs. 90,000/- to Rs. 1,50,000/- per month, fixed within the band according to qualification and experience.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for the NHSRC Senior Consultant post?
faq.answer: Fill the online application on the NHSRC website (http://nhsrcindia.org); applications are accepted only in the prescribed online format.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Selection comprises a written test (objective and subjective), an analytical test, computer proficiency and a personal interview; eligible candidates will be informed separately.

faq.question: Q8. What are the qualifying marks in the written test?
faq.answer: If a written test is held, the minimum qualifying mark is 70%, and if many candidates qualify, the top 5 per vacancy (1:5 ratio) will be considered.

faq.question: Q9. Is the NHSRC Senior Consultant job permanent?
faq.answer: No, it is purely contractual, with the contract till 31st March 2028 and further extensions of similar duration subject to satisfactory performance.

faq.question: Q10. Are distance or part-time degrees accepted?
faq.answer: No, qualifications obtained through distance, online, part-time or correspondence mode, and diploma, certificate or Executive programmes, are not considered under the full-time regular qualification rule.
